verses.text: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus by di command of God our Savior, and of Christ Jesus our hope,
to Timothy, my true pikin for faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God our Papa and Christ Jesus our Lord.
As I beg you when I dey go Macedonia, make you stay for Ephesus so that you go command some people say make dem no teach different doctrine,
and make dem no give attention to story dem wey no be true and to genealogy dem wey no dey end, wey dey cause argument, instead of di work wey God give, wey dey inside faith.
But di goal of dis command na love, wey come from clean heart, good conscience and true faith;
some people don miss dis way and turn go empty talk,
as dem wan be teachers of di law, but dem no understand wetin dem dey talk or wetin dem dey strongly talk say na true.
But we know say di law good, if person use am di right way,

as e know say dem no make law for righteous man, but for dem wey no follow law and dem wey no dey obey, for dem wey no fear God and sinners, for dem wey no holy and dem wey dey spoil holy things, for dem wey kill dem papa and mama, for dem wey kill people,
for dem wey dey do sexual immorality, for men wey dey sleep with men, for dem wey dey sell people as slave, for liars, for dem wey swear false, and for anything wey dey against di sound doctrine,
according to di Good News of di glory of God wey dey blessed, wey dem trust me with.
I thank am wey give me strength, Christ Jesus our Lord, because e count me faithful and put me for im service,
even though before I be person wey dey blaspheme, wey dey persecute and wey get pride. But I receive mercy because I do am without knowing, for unbelief.
Di grace of our Lord overflow well well, with faith and love wey dey inside Christ Jesus.
Dis saying dey true and e deserve make everybody accept am: Christ Jesus come di world to save sinners, and I be di worst among dem.
But na for dis reason I receive mercy, so that Jesus Christ go show all im patience inside me, wey be di worst, as example for dem wey go believe am for life wey no dey end.
Now to di King wey no dey end, wey no dey die, wey nobody fit see, to di only wise God, make honor and glory dey forever and ever. Amen.
Timothy, my pikin, I give you dis charge, according to di prophecy dem wey dem talk about you before, so that through dem you go fight di good fight,
as you hold faith and good conscience, wey some don push away and dem faith don wreck like ship;
among dem na Hymenaeus and Alexander, wey I hand over to Satan so that dem go learn say dem no go blaspheme.
So first of all, I urge make dem make request, prayer, intercession and thanksgiving for all men,
for kings and for all dem wey dey high place, so that we go live quiet and peaceful life with all respect for God and with dignity.
Because dis one good and e dey please God our Savior,
wey want make all people save and come know di truth well.
Because na one God dey, and one mediator dey between God and men, di man Christ Jesus,
wey give imself as ransom for all; na di testimony for di right time,
wey dem put me to be preacher and apostle. I dey talk true for Christ, I no dey lie. Na me be teacher of di Gentiles for faith and truth.
So I want make di men for every place pray, as dem lift up holy hand without anger and doubt.
Na so too, make women dress well for decent cloth, with shame and good sense; no be with braid hair, gold, pearl or costly cloth,
but with good works, as e fit women wey talk say dem dey fear God.
Make woman learn quietly with all submission.
But I no allow woman to teach or to rule over man, but make e dey quiet.
Because dem form Adam first, den Eve.
Dem no deceive Adam, but di woman, wey dem deceive, fall enter disobedience;
but e go save through to born pikin, if dem continue for faith, love and holiness, with good sense.
Dis saying dey true: if man want di work of overseer, e want good work.
So di overseer must be person wey no get fault, husband of one wife, wey dey control imself, wey get clear mind, wey dey orderly, wey dey welcome strangers, and wey fit teach;
no be person wey dey drink too much, no be person wey dey beat people, but gentle, no be person wey like quarrel, no be person wey love money;
person wey rule im own house well, wey make im pikin dem submit with all respect;
because if man no know how to rule im own house, how e go take care of God church?
No be person wey just believe, so that pride no go catch am and e go fall under di same judgment wey di devil get.
Again, e must get good name from dem wey dey outside, so that e no go fall into shame and di trap of di devil.
Na so too di deacons must be people wey get respect, no be double-tongue, no be people wey dey drink plenty wine, no be people wey dey greed for dishonest gain,
as dem hold di mystery of di faith with clean conscience.
Make dem test dem first; den make dem serve as deacons, if dem no get fault.
Na so too dem wives must be women wey get respect, no be slanderers, wey dey control demself, and wey dey faithful for everything.
Make deacons be husband of one wife, and make dem rule dem pikin dem and dem own house well.
Because dem wey serve well as deacons dey win good standing for demself and plenty boldness for di faith wey dey inside Christ Jesus.
I dey write you dese things, as I hope to come meet you soon,
but if I late, make you know how people suppose behave for God house, wey be di church of di God wey dey alive, di pillar and foundation of di truth.

Without argument, di mystery of fear of God big: E show for flesh, dem prove say e righteous for spirit, angels see am, dem preach am among di nations, dem believe am for di world, and dem carry am go up for glory.
But di Spirit talk clear say for di last times some people go leave di faith, as dem go dey follow deceiving spirit dem and teaching of evil spirit dem,
through di hypocrisy of liars, wey dem own conscience don burn like say dem use hot iron mark am;
dem dey forbid marriage and dey command make people no chop some food wey God create so that dem wey believe and know di truth go receive am with thanks.
Because everything wey God create good, and nothing suppose dem reject, if dem receive am with thanks;
because di word of God and prayer make am holy.
If you teach di brothers dese things, you go be good servant of Christ Jesus, wey dey feed on di words of di faith and di good doctrine wey you don follow.
But refuse unholy story dem and old women fables. Make you train to fear God.
Because to train di body get small value, but to fear God get value for everything, as e get promise for di life wey dey now and di one wey dey come.
Dis saying dey true and e deserve make everybody accept am.
Na for dis reason we dey work hard and dem dey insult us, because we don put our trust for di God wey dey alive, wey be Savior of all men, especially of dem wey believe.
Command and teach dese things.
Make nobody despise your youth; but be example to dem wey believe, for word, for how you dey live, for love, for spirit, for faith and for purity.
Until I come, give attention to reading, to encouragement and to teaching.
No ignore di gift wey dey inside you, wey dem give you through prophecy, as di elders put dem hand on you.
Work hard for dese things. Give all your life to dem, so that everybody go see how you dey progress.
Watch your life and your teaching. Continue for dese things, because as you dey do am, you go save you and dem wey dey hear you.
No rebuke old man, but advise am like papa; advise di young men like brothers;
di old women like mama dem; di young women like sisters, with all purity.
Honor widows wey be real widows.
But if any widow get pikin or grandchild, make dem learn first to show respect for dem own family and to pay back dem papa and mama, because dis one dey please God.
Now di widow wey be real widow, wey dem leave alone, don put im hope for God, and e dey continue for request and prayer night and day.
But di one wey dey give imself to pleasure don die even as e dey alive.
Command dem dese things too, so that dem no go get fault.
But if anybody no take care of im own people, especially im own house, e don deny di faith and e worse pass person wey no believe.
Make dem put widow for di list only if e no dey less than 60 years old, as e don be wife of one man,
wey people know for good works: if e don train pikin dem, if e don welcome strangers, if e don wash di feet of holy people, if e don help dem wey dey suffer, if e don follow every good work well.
But no put young widows for di list, because when dem desire dey pull dem comot from Christ, dem go wan marry,
and dem go get condemnation, because dem don break dem first promise.
Again, dem dey learn to dey idle, as dem dey go from house to house. No be only idle, but dem dey gossip and meddle for people matter, as dem dey talk wetin dem no suppose talk.
So I want make young widows marry, born pikin, manage di house, and no give enemy any chance to insult.
Because some don already turn go follow Satan.
If any believer, man or woman, get widows, make e help dem, and make dem no put load on di church, so that di church go fit help dem wey be real widows.
Make dem count di elders wey lead well worthy of double honor, especially dem wey dey labor for di word and for teaching.
Because di Scripture talk say, “You no go tie mouth of ox when e dey tread out di grain.” Again, “Di worker deserve im pay.”
No receive accusation against elder, except two or three witnesses talk am.
Dem wey dey sin, rebuke dem before everybody, so that di rest go fear too.
I charge you before God, and Christ Jesus, and di angels wey God choose, make you keep dese things without prejudice, and no do anything with favoritism.
No put hand quick on anybody, and no join for other people sin. Keep your life pure.
No dey drink only water again, but use small wine for your stomach sake and because of your sickness dem wey dey come often.
Some people sin dey clear, e dey go before dem reach judgment; and for some, di sin dey follow dem come later.
Na so too, some good works dey clear, and di ones wey no clear no fit hide.
Make all di slaves wey dey under yoke count dem own oga worthy of all honor, so that people no go blaspheme di name of God and di doctrine.

Dem wey get oga wey believe, make dem no despise dem because dem na brothers, but make dem serve dem even more, because dem wey dey enjoy di benefit na believers and dem dear. Teach and encourage dese things.
If anybody teach different doctrine and no agree with di sound words, di words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and di doctrine wey follow fear of God,
e don puff up with pride, e no know anything, but e dey sick with argument, dispute and word fight, wey dey cause envy, quarrel, insult and evil suspicion,
and endless quarrel among people wey get spoil mind and wey don lose di truth, wey think say fear of God na way to make money. Comot from such people.
But to fear God with contentment na big gain.
Because we no bring anything enter di world, and we no fit carry anything comot.
But if we get food and cloth, we go dey satisfied with dat.
But dem wey don decide to be rich dey fall into temptation, trap and plenty foolish and harmful desire, wey dey drown people inside ruin and destruction.
Because love of money na root of all kinds of evil. Some people don wander comot from di faith because of dem greed, and dem don wound demself with plenty sorrow.
But you, man of God, run comot from dese things, and follow righteousness, fear of God, faith, love, patience and gentleness.
Fight di good fight of faith. Hold tight di life wey no dey end, wey dem call you go, and you make good confession before plenty witnesses.
I command you before God, wey dey give life to everything, and before Christ Jesus, wey testify di good confession before Pontius Pilate,
make you keep di command without spot and without blame, until our Lord Jesus Christ go appear,
wey God go show for di right time, di blessed and only Ruler, di King of kings and Lord of lords;
na only im no dey die, im dey stay inside light wey nobody fit come near; nobody don see am and nobody fit see am: to am make honor and power wey no dey end dey. Amen.
Command dem wey rich for dis present world make dem no get pride, and make dem no put dem hope for riches wey no dey sure, but for di God wey dey alive, wey dey give us everything plenty to enjoy;
make dem do good, make dem rich for good works, make dem ready to give, and gree to share,
as dem dey keep good foundation for demself for di time wey dey come, so that dem go hold di life wey no dey end wey be real life.
Timothy, guard wetin dem commit to you, turn comot from empty talk and from di arguments of wetin dem dey call knowledge but no be true knowledge,
wey some people claim, and so dem don miss di faith. Grace dey with you. Amen.
